scope: Lab observational attribution only; no strategy or trading change
reader: Use local modules/csv_utils.py read_csv_file via isolated importlib loading; pad ragged rows, no pandas on_bad_lines skipping
naive_time_zone: America/Chicago, documented journal/host convention; naive rows lack stored offsets
price_guard: broker price must round to journal recorded decimal precision (half-even); exact quantity is primary, not guessed round-trip basis
broker_units: individual fill execution or full-completion order aggregation, deduplicated by activity IDs; no arbitrary subset sum
ambiguity: Only unique row-to-execution-set matches with no shared candidate execution across other journal rows; no nearest greedy match
duplicate_policy: Collapse identical rows across source snapshots; identical repeated rows within one source remain ambiguous
signal_exit_context: retained as contemporaneous context; no order linkage asserted without a matched fill
historical_plans: never fabricated from post-hoc journal notes

fee_rules.FEE_REG_CAT_TAF: equity regulatory costs by posted currency; positive adjustments retained
fee_rules.CFEE: crypto pair fees, excluded from stock costs
fee_rules.DIV: only actual posted broker dividend cash

whole_book_pnl: blocked until opening inventory/corporate actions reconciled
